Betreff: PhD opportunities: maths/stats in marine ecology and forest epidemiology
 
Two funded PhD studentships that may be of interest to members of NCSE are now open in the School of Mathematical and Physical Sciences at the University of Sheffield:

Spatially-explicit multi-model ensemble methods for marine ecosystem prediction (in collaboration with Cefas) led by Dr Jill Johnson
https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/spatially-explicit-multi-model-ensemble-methods-for-marine-ecosystem-prediction-in-collaboration-with-cefas-c3-5-mps-johnson/?p199339

Mathematical modelling of the spread and control of sudden larch death in UK forests (in collaboration with Defra) led by Dr Alex Best
https://www.findaphd.com/phds/project/mathematical-modelling-of-the-spread-and-control-of-sudden-larch-death-in-uk-forests-in-collaboration-with-defra-c3-5-mps-best/?p199356

Both are expected to start in September 2027, and have closing dates of January 13th, 2027. For further information please follow the above links (to FindAPhD), contact the lead supervisors (named above; details on FindAPhD) or contact me as co-supervisor on both projects.

Paul Blackwell.

--
Professor Paul Blackwell (he, him, his)
